decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series opens a new customer segment for a small firm with a narrow range, so its results are uncertain against aspirations, but it builds on established production capabilities and the industry's growing turnover gives enough slack to keep carrying it rather than start problemistic search.
The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini series and shares its ingredients, production and customers, so it is cheap to keep and likely meets aspirations, giving little reason to drop it.
